documents.title: Book Closure For The Purpose Of 34Th AGM

analysis.summary: Kernex Microsystems (India) Limited released its investor presentation for FY 2026-27, highlighting robust financial performance with Q1 standalone revenue reaching ₹502.03 crores and a strong order book of ₹3,487 crores. Management detailed significant market opportunities around the Indian Railways Kavach rollout alongside a strategic diversification roadmap into new domains like Yard Management, Intelligent Traffic Management, and AI-BIM Digital Twins. Working capital limits have been enhanced to ₹655 crores to support execution and scaling demands. The company also emphasized its manufacturing capabilities, technical credentials, and long-term structural growth drivers in railway safety systems. Kernex Microsystems reported a significant increase in financial performance for Q3 FY25 and 9M FY25, driven by higher revenue and improved gross contributions.

Entire Indian Railway Network – 85000 KM

guidance.quote:
• KAVACH • KAVACH • KAVACH • KAVACH

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Indian Railways adds approximately 5 new locomotives daily, continuously growing the national rolling stock asset base.
demand_outlook.quote: Expanding Fleet Baseline: Indian Railways adds ~approx 5 new locomotives daily (~1,900+ per annum), continuously growing the national rolling stock asset base.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that 100 percent of newly manufactured rolling stock must eventually be outfitted with ATP or KAVACH modules prior to commissioning.
demand_outlook.quote: Mandatory Regulatory Tailwinds: Per Mandate 100% of newly manufactured rolling stock must be eventually outfitted with (ATP/ KAVACH) modules prior to commissioning.
